Everyday Conversations

B1

Hello, and welcome to our little conversation corner for helping you feel truly confident speaking English in everyday life — chatting at a café, sorting things out at a shop, or making small talk on the street. No pressure, no boring grammar drills — just real words, real conversations, and plenty of friendly practice at your own pace.

B1 Everyday Scenarios

Practise polite, useful conversations for everyday life.

  1. Choose a situation from the drop-down list. There are 21 everyday situations.
  2. Pick a task on the task board, or use the Back and Next buttons to go through all 5 tasks in order.
  3. Study first: listen to the conversation, then learn the words and the polite phrases with the cards next to it. Tap 🔊 to hear them.
  4. Then play: build the replies, guess who says it, fill the gaps and spell the words you hear.
